card.line: The King's Highway was the main road through Edom and the Amorite land, which Israel asked to travel on as they journeyed toward the land God promised.

moments.title: Edom Says No
moments.text: Israel asked to pass through Edom and stay on the King's Highway, promising to pay for any water. Edom refused and came out with a large army, so Israel turned away.

moments.title: Sihon Fights Israel
moments.text: Israel asked King Sihon of the Amorites for the same thing, to stay on the King's Highway. Sihon refused and fought Israel, and Israel took his land and cities, including Heshbon.
